title: Software Development Security learning paths

fast.method: Trace one feature from risk and requirements through a controlled release, then diagnose its coding and API boundaries.

standard.method: Study each overview and child unit, then apply controls to a CI/CD, supplier, API, and production-operations scenario.

reinforcement.method: Reconstruct source weaknesses, pipeline provenance, SDLC gates, dependency decisions, and evidence loops from memory.

completionEvidence: Can place security activities across an SDLC and methodology
Can secure a development toolchain and assess software supply risk
Can explain secure coding and API controls with testing and operational evidence
